actual_tools: CZ CELLxGENE Discover API via cellxgene-skill and local Python standard library
execution.implementation: Genuine Rosalind task-chooser observation plus deterministic QC of 15 official breast-cancer Visium metadata records

observations: The retained official collection response contains 15 Visium Spatial Gene Expression V1 datasets and 74,880 capture spots.
Eleven datasets are labelled triple-negative breast carcinoma and four are labelled normal.
All records contain a spatial embedding and none reports a full-resolution image asset.
The retained public-metadata extract omits study participant pseudonyms and preserves only aggregate participant counts.
A genuine Rosalind Workbench open call returned the exact task-chooser-ready message.
interpretation: The metadata is sufficient for study-level QC planning and shows substantial between-dataset variation in the reported mean genes per spot.
limitations: No expression matrix, spot coordinate, image pixel, or pathology region was analysed.
Metadata summaries do not establish biological differences between disease groups.
The de-identified extract cannot reconstruct which datasets came from the same participant; participant-aware modelling requires a fresh authorized source retrieval.
rosalind_open only opened the task chooser and did not run a spatial analysis.

provenance.note: The official collection response and local script support the metadata QC; the separate 898-byte Rosalind observation supports launcher readiness only.

reproduction: Run python showcases/rosalind-workbench/cases/rosalind-breast-visium/build_case.py from the repository root.
Require collection bfd55632-15e2-4dde-a1b9-02ade511fc4d, 15 Visium datasets, and 74,880 total spots.
Treat the Rosalind launcher receipt separately from the CELLxGENE metadata analysis.
